notes.title: Only one week until Slice the Ice will launch!
notes.notes:
Are you as excited as me? Only one week until Slice the Ice will launch! I really, really hope you will like my little physics puzzler. It my seem easy, but solving each level with a perfect score is a task that will keep you busy for hours. Hopefully some hours full of fun. :) Wanna share your score? Steam leaderboards are fully integrated!

You can even try the game now - for free - on you Android or Apple device:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fancyfactory.slicetheice
https://itunes.apple.com/app/slice-the-ice/id372344620?mt=8

notes.title: Slice the Ice is coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
[h1]Slice the Ice is coming to Steam![/h1]

Finally!! My mobile game, already available for Android and iOS, is coming to Steam early in December: 

[url]http://store.steampowered.com/app/750740/Slice_the_Ice/[/url]

Until then check out this cute physics puzzler for Android devices and iPhone/iPad:

[url]https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fancyfactory.slicetheice[/url]
[url]https://itunes.apple.com/app/slice-the-ice/id372344620?mt=8[/url]

I really hope you will like it! :)

Regards, Axel
